description: South Korea legal cap on rent increases at renewal: 5% for housing leases, and 5% for commercial leases whose converted deposit (deposit + monthly rent x 100) is within the regional threshold (Seoul 900M, overconcentration areas and Busan 690M, other metropolitan cities 540M, elsewhere 370M).

region.description: Region, commercial leases only; default seoul

name: rent_increase_limit
